Cookie Policy

Which cookies blueoceanluxury.co.za uses, why, and how to change your choice.

Draft for legal review. Last updated 20 November 2026. This policy applies to blueoceanluxury.co.za, operated by Blue Ocean Realty (Pty) Ltd, Suite 6, 66 Adelaide Tambo Drive, Durban North, 4051.

What is a cookie?

A cookie is a small text file a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies, such as local storage, work the same way and are covered by this policy.

Which cookies does this site use?

  • Essential (always on): remembers your cookie choice (bor_consent_v1, 12 months) and keeps an advertising click reference for your current visit only (bor_attribution, session) so it can be attached to an enquiry you send. These do not track you across other websites.
  • Analytics (only with your consent): Google Analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_*, up to 2 years) count visits and show which listings are viewed. We use this to decide which properties to feature.
  • Advertising (only with your consent): Google Ads cookies (_gcl_*, up to 90 days) record that you clicked one of our advertisements, so Google Ads can report which advertisements led to an enquiry. With this consent the advertising click reference is also kept for up to 90 days.

How do I accept, reject or change my choice?

When analytics or advertising is active, a banner asks for your choice on your first visit. Nothing in the analytics or advertising categories runs until you accept. You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of every page, or by clearing this site's data in your browser.

Who receives this information?

Analytics and advertising data is processed by Google Ireland Limited and Google LLC. Google may process it outside South Africa. See Google's privacy policy at policies.google.com/privacy. Enquiry forms are delivered by FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) to our office email.

Who do I contact?

Information Officer, Blue Ocean Realty (Pty) Ltd: info@blueoceanluxury.co.za or +27 69 522 4226. Your rights under POPIA are set out in our privacy policy.
